messages.subject: Using scales = "free" with coord_flip()
parts:
I am trying to generate some plots using the following code:

H + geom_bar(stat="identity",binwidth = 1) + coord_flip() + facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free")

but get the message that "ggplot2 does not currently support free scales with a non-cartesian coord or coord_flip". Is there a work around? Or a fix planned? An example of the old plot is attached. I am using ggplot2 v0.9.3.1.

Thanks,
Kevin
